name: card_post_project_visual_website
title: Card Post Project Visual - Website
description: Renders a project's website preview as a laptop + phone device mockup, for posts in the "Web Development Projects" category. Device model (per type) is auto-picked from the project's type/start year, or can be forced. Device frame images and per-type/model paths come from data_content_post_projects.json (img.devices).
